tei:div.tei:p: (437)srid pa'i 'dre lnga'i glud bsdus ngag gi'o/ hrīḥ bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo ni// che mchog padma badzra rtsal// dmar gsal drang srong khros pa'i nyams// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa// lha lcam yum dang gnyis med 'khril// bde chen ngang du 'od du zhu// de las skad cig dran rdzogs su// bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sku/ (438)/mdog dmar dus mtha'i me dpung bzhin// 'jigs rung gar gyi nyams dgu ldan// g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje gdengs// khro chung tshwa tsha skar ltar 'khrugs// g.yon pas lcags kyi phur pa 'debs// lcags sdig nag po grangs med 'gyed// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// zhabs la sag ti'i rgya lham mnab// ral pa khams nag sprin ltar gtib// las bzhi lhun grub rta skad 'tsher// dus gsum bde gshegs las la bskul// (439)sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dam chos ma lus 'dus pa'i gsung*// rig 'dzin ma lus thugs las shar// ye nas rang dang gnyis su med// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gsal/ oṃ swa bha

sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rten 'byung 'gags pa med pa'i rol mo cir yang 'char ba las rin po che'i pho brang mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar pho tang mo tang rgyang bu nam mkha' mda' 'phang chang bu la sogs pa'i dngos su 'byor pa dang yid (440)kyis sprul pa las byung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyi dbang po drug gi yul du gang la mkho ba'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por gyur: sngags drug phyag drug gis brlab te/ hrīḥ ngang nyid dbyings las rang snang ba'i// nga ni padma badzra rtsal// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre dang*/ khyad par srid pa'i 'dre lnga la// phog pas sngon gyi tha tshig (441)bzhin// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// rnam dag byang chub sems nyid la// ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags las// gzung 'dzin rtog pa zhen pa yis// zhe sdang rang gar bzung ba'i rtsal// btsun pa rang rgyud rgyal po ste// g.yul 'khrugs srog la rngam pa'i 'dre// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// 'dod pa rang rgyud brten pa las// btsun ma gson bdud 'dre mo sri// bud med bse mo'i gzugs su shar/ kha smras gleng mo (442)byed pa'i 'dre// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// nga rgyal rmongs pa rang ga bar/ zhen pa'i byis pa ngar 'dzin pas// srid pa the'u rang ja la ma// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// phrag dog 'dzin pas bcings pa'i bdag /sngags pa sems ngan dam sri yin// dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i 'dre// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// dug lnga rang stobs bsdo ba la// sde dpon ma rung yul 'dre srid// gnas gzhi yul khams phung ba'i 'dre// srid (443)pa'i mdos la da tshur byon/ khyed rnams 'khor du gtogs pa'i bdag /srid pa'i 'dre dgu gdon bcu dang*/ dam sri yul 'dre thams cad kun// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur shog

/srid pa mdos kyi rwa ba 'dir// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas/ khyed kyi gnas su bkas bcad pas// 'di na longs spyod phun sum tshogs// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// bza' ba'i zas dang btung ba'i skom// gnas (444)grogs mgon dang bra na 'bangs bcas// yid la 'dod dgu 'dzom pa yi// mdos kyi gzhal yas khang la bzhugs// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' la nyon/ sambha ra dang mtshan bzhin bsngos la/ kyai/ srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor dang bcas/ khyod la 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams// rang rang yid la gang 'dod pa'i// zag med gter du brlab ste sbyin// pho brang ba gam g.yu las byas// rin chen sna tshogs rtsig pa la// bye ru dmar po'i kha bad mdzes// gser gyi (445)rgya phib rgyal mtshan brgyan// gru bzhi kun nas 'khor ba las// dung gi sgo mo g.yu yis mdzes// nyi ma zla ba'i skar khung gsal// nang du longs spyod dpag tu med// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// gnas mal 'dug pa'i rten du bsngo// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// stag pa'i pho tang mtshar bas bkrag /stag shar mda' gral gshib pa brgya// thabs mchog skyes pa pho yi glud// phrag (446)pa g.yas su mda' yis mtshon// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// lus kyi rten du khyod la bsngo// glang ma'i mo tang g.yu bas gsal// bud med 'phang gral tshogs pa brgya// shes rab za ma mo yi glud// phrag pa g.yon du 'phang gis brgyan// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// lus kyi rten du khyod la bsngo// mtho ba sgang na 'grim pa'i tshe// snyan pa'i glu len kyu ru ru// dma' ba thang nas 'gro ba'i tshe// mdzes pa'i (447)ldem bag chags zhing 'gro// lha 'dre pho yi char gtogs na// dgyes sde glang ma'i mo tang bzang*// lha 'dre mo yi char gtogs na/ khyo pho stag pa'i pho tang rung*// lho smyug ldem pa'i ljon shing la// bal tshon kha dog mdzes pas brgyan// sgo gsum mtshon pa'i tshig gsum pa// rgyang bu ngag gi rten du sbyin// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// kun gzhi sems kyi nam mkha' (448)la// nyon mongs lnga yi snal mas 'brel// tshogs brgyad rtog pa'i bya spus brgyan// gru bzhi kun nas lham me ba// lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can la// 'byung ba sems kyi rten du sbyin// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// thabs kyi smyug ma ldem pa la// shes rab sgro dang dar gyis spras// thabs shes 'brel ba'i mda' bkra 'di// skyes pa pho yi glud la sbyin// thabs kyi bsom shing drang ba la/

shes rab snal ma thag chas (449)sbrel// thabs shes 'brel ba'i 'phang bkra 'di// za ma mo yi glud la sbyin// ston pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas// chang bu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// dbang po drug gi spyod yul du// longs spyod zad pa med par bsngo// sha dum zan chad gos ras dang*// dong tshe mig mang rtags brgyad ris// rgyal srid sna bdun yul 'khor dang*// sa gzhi rgya mtsho ri rab dang*// nyi zla gza' skar 'ja' tshon ris/ 'dod (450)'jo'i ba dang cang shes rta// ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing*// gter chen bum pa bdud rtsi'i mtsho// ma tshang med pa'i yas rdzas rnams// bsngo ba nga yi ma nor gyis// len pa khyod kyis ma nor cig /skyes pa pho yis glud du bsngo// srid pa'i byol zor bzlog tu gsol// za ma mo yi glud du bsngo// chags che nyams nga bsgyur du gsol// mo ngan rmi lam ngan pa bsgyur// than dang ltas ngan bsgyur du gsol// dmag dang (451)'khrugs pa rtsod pa bsgyur// ngan smras gleng mo bsgyur du gsol// zhi zhing byams pa'i sems kyis su// srid pa'i mdos la dga' bas longs// phan pa'i sems kyis gnas su song*// phyin chad gnod pa ma ston cig 'dra glud bsngo bani/ kyai/ mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan che// phung po khams dang skye mched tshang*// zer mo'i skra bzang dar bas ljang*/ long thang mig 'bras shin tu gsal// (452)srab legs dar dmar lce bde zhing*// bse rus sha la mtshal gyi khrag /dung rus spu shel rtsa rgyus la// brgya byin lag pa'i skye mched mdzes// mi bas glud bzang skye mched tshang*/ sngags kyi nus pas shes zhing gsal// smra mkhas 'gros ldem dar zab brgyan// bla bas bza' che dkor cha 'jom// nad pa bslu ba'i yon du bsngo// lus kyi glud du ngar mi dang*// tshe yi glud du ting lo dang*// bla yi glud du mar me rnams// (453)rnal 'byor ting 'dzin dag pas bsngo// ngar mi glud phran rgyal 'bangs 'dzom// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// bsngo zhing sbyin pas tshim gyur cig

/bde mchog 'khor lo'i bka' ma bcag /dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dam ma bkral// rnal 'byor bdag gi tshig ma bslu// rang rang so so'i gnas su song*// sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ma lta ma rngams ma sems par// (454)ri rab gling bzhi'i byang ngos na// sgra mi snyan pa longs spyod che// nor la bdag pos bzung ma myong*// zas la phongs pa'i bsam pa med// de ru 'dre lnga da gshegs shig /srid pa 'phrul gi mdos chen 'di// bkrag gsal snang stong sgyu ma yin// gang du chags kyang phrag ma dog /gang du grub kyang ru ma nga*/ gsal stong nam mkha'i ngang nyid du// chos rnams thams cad de ltar blta/ chos sbyin byas nas lo bdud steng du bsgyur ro/ (455)bca' thabs pho brang shing ris nam rgyang chang bu ting lo sha dum zan dum gos sen 'bru sna sogs gang 'byor/ sbyin bdag 'dra glud dang ngar phran ci mang*/ dbus su rgyal po bande btsun gzugs/ g.yas su bud med nag mo bya rog mgo mdun du byis pa/ g.yon du pho mtshan dmar po gyen 'greng*/ rgyab tu khyi dmar po rnams bsags go ༈ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdud kyi rgyal po bdud kyi rje// rkos rje drang dkar 'dir gshegs shig /btsan rgod ri bkra 'dir gshegs shig /phyi nang mchod pa'i dam tshig rdzas// mthun pa'i g.yag nag zhol po dang*// bya nag lug nag spyi dkar dang*// khyi nag bya nag tshogs kyi bskang*// 'bru sna phye mar bsang dud dang*// gser skyems sman dang sha sna dang*// dar tshon stag gzig dkor cha mchod// gnas mgron gnyis kyi chad tho la// ma g.yel 'byung po'i rgyu 'phrang bsrung*// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces rnams rdo rje 'chang ngag gi dbang pos gsungs/// ///////////////////////////////////
